title: Comment on: “Evaluating the performance of general vs retrieval-augmented generation large language models on oral and maxillofacial surgery board examinations”
html: I read with great interest the recent article by Joachim et al.1, who compared the performance of general-purpose large language models (LLMs) with a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) implementation using oral and maxillofacial surgery board examinations. The study addresses a timely and clinically relevant topic, and its systematic comparison of multiple contemporary LLMs provides valuable information for educators and clinicians interested in the expanding role of artificial intelligence in oral and maxillofacial surgery.
